response.query: [What are the top creative and high-quality trends in Business, Economics, and Management?]
response.answer: Key trends in business, economics, and management include generative AI for efficiency, skills-based hiring, and sustainable business practices. Focus on circular economy and climate-related innovations is growing. Global urbanization and digital transformation are major drivers.

results.title: Seven Trends to Watch in 2025 | Working Knowledge - Baker Library
results.content: **Harvard Business School faculty** highlight some of the major trends leaders might face in 2025 and share insights from their research to help navigate them. As the incoming Trump administration pushes sharply increased US tariffs, it is critical for business leaders and policymakers to understand how these policies shape trade and firm activity. During the 2018-2019 US-China trade war under the last Trump administration, some firms adapted to higher US tariffs on Chinese goods by rerouting through third-party countries, such as Vietnam, effectively sidestepping the levies. Skills-based hiring represented one of the major trends in human resource management over the last several years. Achieving higher levels of conversion will require companies to develop practices that improve skills-based hiring, such as training managers how to evaluate candidates skills first and improving onboarding programs. In studying AI's impact on creative problem-solving, we conducted a global challenge seeking sustainable business ideas in the circular economy.
